claims.evidence: Each fileName and projectAccessions checked against PXD056094; selected inventory is an exact disjoint instrument subset.
RAW stems encode the object accession, sampling spot and material; paper Tables 1 and 2 identify museum accessions and sample descriptions.

The specimens are ancient paint/adhesive fragments from artifacts containing mixed or unidentified animal and plant protein sources. The proteome taxon is an analytical result, not a single known source organism.

claims.location: characteristics[organism part], characteristics[cell type], characteristics[disease] all rows
claims.evidence: Ancient pigment/ground/adhesive material, not a biological tissue, cell population or diseased subject.

claims.location: comment[cleavage agent details] two repeated columns
claims.evidence: Protein extraction Methods specify 2 h rLysC and overnight Trypsin. PRIDE protocol prose summarizes Trypsin only; reconciler considers only first repeated column, so its warning is a false positive.
Methods nanoLC-MS/MS say all samples other than AE1045/AE1060 used Q Exactive HF-X; these are the other 25 raw files.

claims.location: comment[proteomics data acquisition method] all rows
claims.evidence: Methods nanoLC-MS/MS specify data-dependent top 10 mode.

claims.location: comment[precursor mass tolerance], comment[fragment mass tolerance]
claims.evidence: MS/MS data analysis Methods specify MS1 and MS2 measurement errors.

claims.value: carbamidomethyl C fixed; oxidation M, deamidation N/Q and N-terminal pyroglutamate from Q/E variable
claims.evidence: These modifications are specified in MS/MS data analysis. Methods also list collagen-specific hydroxyproline, not encoded here because its use differs among samples; see limitations.

limitations: The depositor run list does not include blank-control RAW files; all 28 deposited RAW files are mapped.
The paper reports taxonomic identifications per sample as analytical results, sometimes multiple taxa. A single source organism is not asserted for mixed paint/adhesive artifacts.
Collagen-specific hydroxyproline search is not represented because its use differs among samples.
The primary paper assigns two instrument methods; PRIDE project-level instrument field lists HF-X and is not valid for the AE1045/AE1060 subset.
